title: A voyage starts on a clean tree: /sail stashes leftover work and raises a trouble naming it
intention: When a voyage starts at /sail, any uncommitted change in cairn or CairnCommons raises a trouble and is stashed under a name the trouble carries, so the voyage starts on a clean tree and the leftover work can be found and restored.
why: Ruling 8w (Akien, verbatim: "yes, rework them that way. and cc++"), layer 2, as narrowed by F11 ("that all sounds good :)"), /home/akien/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md. The one measured orphan (3fef5a02da2d's lab rows, 413 lines across its PROVEME and PROVED crossings) stood across 6 compactions because nothing looked at the tree when the next voyage started. 5bc3a4b1ab27 crossed PROVED with its verdict run on 68cef2ddd8ef's held, unproved build still in the tree (ruling 8t). A clean start makes both impossible, and the stash keeps the work restorable instead of lost. Replaces 7bb99eed0629.
traces_to: Law 8 and ruling 8t (a crossing must not lean on another ticket's unproved build: a clean start makes the measured 5bc3/68ce case impossible); Law 7 (an orphan is loud, as a trouble, never silent dirt); Law 6 and 8u (orphans are ours, cc or the builder, and are attributed, never removed blind). RULE 1: the sweep lives in skills/sail and reaches orient and the diagnostic base only through their declared interfaces.
how: (a) skills/sail/sweep.py with `sweep(repos: list[Path] | None = None, *, ticket: str = '', raiser=None, journal: Path | None = None, now=None) -> dict | None`. repos defaults to [ROOTS['repo'], ROOTS['commons']] from cairn.tools.base.address. journal defaults to cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.journal_path(ROOTS['commons']). raiser defaults to ModuleRaiser('sail'). (b) rows = repo_truth(repos=repos)['measured']['repos'] (measured at orient.py:313-316). For each row with a non-empty `dirty`: run `git -C <repo> stash push -u -m 'sail-sweep <ticket> <now iso>'`, then sha = `git -C <repo> rev-parse stash@{0}`. Record {repo, paths: dirty, stash: sha}. (c) Suspects: read the journal lines newest-first, take the first whose path matches ^tickets/([0-9a-f]{12})-, and return [that id, 'Akien'], or ['Akien'] if none is found or the file is absent. (d) If any repo was dirty: record = raiser.raise_trouble('orphaned-changes-at-sail', why='uncommitted changes stood in the tree when a voyage started; stashed so the voyage starts clean — probably leftover work from the last ticket, or Akien', detail={'ticket': ticket, 'repos': [...], 'suspects': [...], 'restore': 'git -C <repo> stash apply <sha>'}). Return the record, else None. (e) `python3 -m skills.sail.sweep <ticket>` prints the record or 'clean'. (f) SKILL.md gains step '0. Sweep the tree' between 0a and the chart step: run `PYTHONPATH=$HOME/dev/src/cairn python3 -m skills.sail.sweep <id>` first. (g) The proof file skills/sail/proofs/test_sail_sweeps_the_tree_first.py, with PROVES keyed on this ticket, clauses 1-5, one tooth each. It passes repos, journal and a ModuleRaiser('sail', roots={...tempdir...}) explicitly, never the live roots. Fixtures are built with `git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t`. PROOF_TIMEOUT_S = 120. Run only via bin/cairn test --netns.
falsifier: Done when skills/sail/proofs/test_sail_sweeps_the_tree_first.py is green under bin/cairn test --netns. Fixtures are two git repos (cairn-like and commons-like) in a tempdir, with ModuleRaiser roots in that tempdir. (1) With one modified tracked file and one untracked file in EACH repo, sweep(repos=[a, b], ...) returns ONE trouble record whose detail names all four paths, grouped per repo, and one stash sha per repo. Afterwards repo_truth `dirty` is [] in both. (2) `git stash apply <sha>` with each sha from the trouble restores every one of the four paths byte-identical to its pre-sweep content. (3) Suspects follow the commons journal: with a fixture journal whose newest tickets/ line names ticket aaaaaaaaaaaa (an older line names bbbbbbbbbbbb), the trouble's suspects equal ['aaaaaaaaaaaa', 'Akien']. With no journal, they equal ['Akien']. (4) With both repos clean, sweep returns no trouble, raises nothing, and `git stash list` is unchanged in both. (5) With dirt only in the commons-like repo, exactly one stash is made, there, and the cairn-like repo's stash list is unchanged. Red at HEAD 06e77582: no skills/sail/sweep.py. Horizon: this voyage.
watchme: none, because the trouble it raises IS its live signal: every sweep that finds dirt lands as trouble 'orphaned-changes-at-sail' in the CC lane of the session banner (bin/cmd/slate _live_troubles), whose count says how often voyages start dirty
children: none, because one module and one SKILL.md step in skills/sail plus one proof in skills/sail/proofs; layer 3 is a sibling ticket in build_inspector, not a child
questions: none, because the shape is ruled (8w: "yes, rework them that way. and cc++"; F11: "that all sounds good :)", /home/akien/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md) and the teeth go to Akien for clearance through the peer at this cast
gates_bound: Proved: skills/sail/proofs/test_sail_sweeps_the_tree_first.py green and sealed under bin/cairn test --netns, five teeth under PROVES for this ticket. A hollow reverting skills/sail/sweep.py reds every tooth. Feeds back to origin on failure (a red returns the boat to FIXME).
